requirements.title: A NULLIFY statement is NULLIFY with a parenthesized pointer-object list
requirements.definition: The grammar for nullify-stmt is exactly NULLIFY ( pointer-object-list ). The keyword, left parenthesis, nonempty pointer-object-list, and right parenthesis are required by this syntax rule; the admissible pointer-object forms and POINTER attribute requirement are supplied by R943 and C956.

requirements.definition: The grammar for pointer-object in a NULLIFY statement admits exactly variable-name, structure-component, or proc-pointer-name. C956 then requires each such object to have the POINTER attribute.

requirements.title: Each NULLIFY pointer object shall have the POINTER attribute
requirements.definition: For each R943 pointer-object in a NULLIFY statement, the object shall have the POINTER attribute. A nonpointer variable name, nonpointer structure component, or nonpointer procedure name is not a conforming pointer-object for NULLIFY.

requirements.title: Pointer objects in the same NULLIFY statement shall be independent
requirements.definition: A pointer-object in a NULLIFY statement shall not depend on the value, bounds, or association status of another pointer-object in the same NULLIFY statement.

pending.no-value-dependence: PENDING diagnostic/control source with an INTEGER pointer ip used as a subscript in another pointer-object such as boxes(ip)%p while ip also appears in the same NULLIFY statement. Repair by using a nonpointer scalar index or by splitting statements, then observe both pointers disassociated. The violation is attributed to S9.7.2-001 after confirming both listed objects otherwise have POINTER attribute.

requirements.title: Execution of NULLIFY disassociates each pointer object
requirements.definition: Execution of a NULLIFY statement causes each pointer-object in its list to become disassociated.
